name: +1 Speed Freddy Escape
desc:
📚 Welcome To +1 speed Freddy Escape🐻

❓ HOW TO PLAY: ❓
📌 You’re trapped in a haunted pizzeria packed with killer animatronics… can you escape?
🏃‍♂️ Run through dark halls, squeeze past broken doors, and dodge roaming animatronics!
🧠 Listen for footsteps, watch the cameras, and time your moves to survive!
💰 Earn cash by reaching checkpoints, finding key items, and escaping each stage!
📈 Upgrade your speed, stamina, flashlight power, and stealth to outsmart the night shift traps!

⚡ Get faster and smarter every run and master the art of surviving the pizzeria!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and prove you’re the #1 escape artist!
🎮 Can you ESCAPE every level of animatronic madness?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support more scary escapes!
🔔 Join our group for exclusive rewards and game news!
